security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Makes your screen feel like paper.
bundle.longDescription: Vellum lays a subtle paper texture over your screens, so they feel less like a light source and more like a page. Nine papers, an optional desk lamp glow, day and night papers, and it turns itself off in the apps you choose. Clicks always go straight through. Free and open source, on Windows, macOS and Linux.
